mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 3.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that suppresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.5, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% indicates a deteriorating labor market that reduces corporate earnings prospects, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL rises above 335.0, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 335.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400.0, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST < 1400.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.5% and the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals dual economic stress that reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.5 AND UNRATE > 4.5, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1400.0 and industrial production falls below 102.0, it signals a broad economic contraction that reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST < 1400.0 AND INDPRO < 102.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion with GDP growth above 2.0% and a quarterly growth rate decline exceeding 0.5 percentage points, the S&P 500 tends to produce positive forward returns as the market anticipates a potential policy pivot before the cycle ends.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% and quarterly growth rate decline > 0.5pp
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% and quarterly growth rate decline > 0.5pp, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation restrictive policy regime (CPIAUCSL > 330.0 and FEDFUNDS > 3.5), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative forward returns as the market prices in the risk of a recession.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 330.0 AND FEDFUNDS > 3.5, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
